decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application documentation Product Information, CK direct and CK direct Xract 2100 submitted 12 April 2011, plans H/04 submitted 17 February 2011 and plans Equipement Specification H/01 and H/02 submitted 10 February 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the following times 8.00am to 11.00pm.

Condition : 4 - Refuse storage for the premises shall comprise not more than one 1100L Eurobin waste storage bins together with separate facilities for the separation and storage of glass, metal, plastics, cardboard, food waste and other recyclable materials, which shall then be collected and taken to a suitable facility for recycling. The storage shall be made permanently available within three months of the date of this permission and no waste shall be stored outside the site other than in approved storage containers in the designated area. The lids of the Eurobin and other storage containers shall be kept shut at all times other than when waste is being emptied into them or being removed from site. Non-recyclable and perishable waste shall be removed from site no less frequently than once a week.
description: Change of use of the premises from A1 use (shop) to A3 use (Cafe) including installation of a kitchen extract duct on the rear elevation.
